workflow_comment: From my perspective, Vollee can provide a useful starting point for feedback. However, there were times when the feedback felt somewhat generic or did not fully capture the nuance of student responses, requiring additional instructor review and adjustment. I also think it is important to maintain opportunities for personalized feedback and instructor judgment, especially in assignments that benefit from human interpretation and relationship-building.
preferred_ai_model: AI provides formative feedback only; I grade all submissions independently.
additional_comment:
The AI-generated scores were somewhat helpful as a starting point, but I still relied heavily on professional judgement to ensure accuracy and fairness.
I think the current model is most appropriate when AI is used as a support tool rather than the primary grader.
I would support continuing AI-assisted grading if instructors remain actively involved in reviewing scores and personalizing feedback.
My preferred model is one where AI helps identify trends, draft comments, and suggest targeted recommendations/resources, while instructors make final grading decisions and provide meaningful formative feedback.
AI can help improve efficiency, but human feedback is still essential for nuance, context, and building student connection and growth.
